title: InfoJini - Senior Data Analyst ETL - Alex Gak
agency_path: City of New York > Employees' Retirement System
description_text: NYCERS had determined there is a need to hire a senior data analyst consultant with Extract, Transform, Load be responsible for detailed field level analysis, metadata analysis, profiling, and mapping of VSAM files into relational/dimensional SQL tables as well as conversion/validation efforts as part of an enterprisewide Legacy Replacement program; the senior data analyst will create and maintain the master data dictionary, and assist in database design of NYCERS mission-critical applications and inventory of its components.
